constraints: shape must match on_true and on_false shapes

on_true.description: array containing entries to return where ``pred`` is True. Must have the same shape as ``pred``, and the same shape and dtype as ``on_false``.
constraints: on_true and on_false must have the same dtype

on_false.description: array containing entries to return where ``pred`` is False. Must have the same shape as ``pred``, and the same shape and dtype as ``on_true``.
constraints: same shape and dtype as on_true
on_true and on_false must have the same dtype

output.description: array with same shape and dtype as ``on_true`` and ``on_false``.

constraints: on_true and on_false must have the same dtype
